items.title: A.J. Brown: Remains listed as limited Tuesday
items.body_text: Brown (ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Tuesday's practice report. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Davante Adams: Placed on injured reserve by Rams
items.body_text: Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Sits out Tuesday's walk-through
items.body_text: Monangai (thumb/toe) was listed as a non-participant in Tuesday's walk-through. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: On practice field Tuesday
items.body_text: Brown (ankle) was spotted on the practice field Tuesday, according to Mike Reiss of ESPN.com. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terry McLaurin: Suffers torn patellar tendon
items.body_text: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon during Monday's loss to the 49ers, according to John Keim of ESPN.com. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
